page_title: NAP 1-1 INT | Napoli v Inter 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' What a wasted opportunity by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Josep Martinez makes a decent save to thwart him.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A player from Inter commits a rough challenge. Daniele Doveri blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
88' Nikita Contini (Napoli) gets a yellow card, off the field.
87' 1 - 1 Goal! Philip Billing (Napoli) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
82' Substitution. Leonardo Spinazzola walks off the pitch and Mathias Olivera (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
82' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) replacing Matteo Politano.
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Davide Frattesi (Inter) for Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
80' Alessandro Bastoni will be replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
80' Matteo Politano (Napoli) puts a poor free kick into the box that Josep Martinez easily collects.
79' Antonio Conte prepares a substitution. Billy Gilmour is replaced by Philip Billing (Napoli).

79' It looks like Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) saw red with that tackle. Daniele Doveri won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Napoli will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Noah Okafor (Napoli) replaces Giacomo Raspadori.
75' Matteo Politano (Napoli) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
72' Simone Inzaghi (Inter) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
71' Scott McTominay (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' Yann Bisseck (Inter) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Nicolo Barella (Inter) tries to find Denzel Dumfries, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
69' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
68' Daniele Doveri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Denzel Dumfries (Inter). A free kick is awarded to Napoli.
65' The substitution is prepared. Joaquin Correa (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marcus Thuram.
65' Scott McTominay (Napoli) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Josep Martinez.
65' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
64' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
62' Some great controlled play and passing from Inter. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
62' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
60' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
60' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 10:3.
59' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Inter will take a throw-in.
58' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
55' It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
54' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) tries to find Lautaro Martinez, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
52' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

51' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
51' Substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu makes his way off the pitch and Piotr Zielinski (Inter) comes on as his replacement.
51' Simone Inzaghi is forced to make a change. Federico Dimarco (Inter) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Benjamin Pavard.
51' Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
47' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
46' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Doveri starts the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends the corner into the box, but Alex Meret intercepts it and averts the threat.
45+4' The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
45+4' Federico Dimarco (Inter) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
45+1' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
45+1' The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
44' Inter are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
42' The free kick is delivered by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

42' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Doveri with no other option than to blow for a foul. Inter are awarded a free kick.
41' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Nicolo Barella (Inter).

40' Federico Dimarco does well to cross from a difficult angle and find Marcus Thuram (Inter) on the edge of the six-yard box, but his header slips well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
39' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) takes the corner with a short pass.

38' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) and Giacomo Raspadori have been trying to find each other with some accurate passes ever since the match started. These two definitely combine the most and are the team's most creative players.
36' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
35' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
32' Matteo Politano (Napoli) switches the play to Scott McTominay and their attacking move continues.
32' Federico Dimarco (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Doveri no option but to blow his whistle.
31' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

30' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
27' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
26' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner but it's cleared.
25' Alex Meret (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Meret intercepts the ball.
22' 0 - 1 Federico Dimarco (Inter) scores from a free kick after smashing the ball over the defensive wall and into the top left corner of the goal!
22' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
20' Federico Dimarco (Inter) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
19' Scott McTominay (Napoli) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Josep Martinez is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
18' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
18' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
16' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
14' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
13' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Romelu Lukaku latches onto his pass.
10' The game is interrupted now, Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
8' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Billy Gilmour (Napoli) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.

6' Federico Dimarco (Inter) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. It's a free kick to Napoli, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
4' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) sends an accurate short pass. Stanislav Lobotka controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
2' Napoli keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
1' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Doveri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Napoli will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri is introduced as the referee for today's match.
